title: Grilled Oysters with German-Style Salsa
description: A refreshing and flavorful seafood dish perfect for a post-workout meal or a light lunch. The combination of tangy German-style salsa and grilled oysters will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Rinse the oysters under cold water, scrubbing to remove any grit.
Pat oysters dry with a paper towel.
Season oysters with salt and pepper.
Grill oysters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until the edges start to curl.
Meanwhile, combine lemon juice, parsley, red onion, German mustard, and mayonnaise in a bowl.
To serve, place a grilled oyster on each plate and top with a spoonful of the German-style salsa.
